evals.prompt: We're adding Sentry to our app. Anything privacy-related to configure?
evals.expected_output: Recommends disabling default PII capture, scrubbing request bodies, headers, and cookies in before_send, avoiding user emails in user context (use IDs), and checking retention and data region.
expectations: Scrubs bodies, headers, or cookies before sending
Uses user IDs rather than emails in error context

evals.prompt: Our 'export my data' feature only includes the users table. Is that enough?
evals.expected_output: Explains that an access/export should cover personal data across all stores (orders, support tickets, logs where feasible, analytics, files), maps where data lives, and lists gaps.
expectations: Identifies other stores holding the user's personal data
Lists specific gaps in the export

evals.prompt: Put the user's email in the password reset URL so the page can pre-fill it.
evals.expected_output: Advises against personal data in URLs (logged by servers, proxies, analytics, referrers), and suggests using only the opaque token and looking up the email server-side.
expectations: Explains why emails in URLs leak
Proposes using only the reset token in the URL
